items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: (Elly,) I've forgotten even what my first name was.

ctx.x: Song and dance team. (Elly,) I've forgotten even what my first name was. I can't remember.

In the show. But I played Show Boat for Lee (Goobert?) on the Camden, New Jersey Music Fair and the Valley Forge Music Fair for two weeks a piece down there and he wanted to give me more parts but they didn't pay too much money so I figured, I said, I'm going back to that cornet. (LAUGHTER). So I can make some money here, again. (LAUGHTER).
